stops.note: the name for small steamed grains of crushed durum wheat
from Berber 'seksu'; French colonial rule in Algeria popularized it in France
stops.meaning: a North African dish of steamed wheat grains

stops.note: first recorded in English around 1593; the Arabic form is often linked to 'kaskasa', to pound
